subject: water
crop: Centred square crop covering the tile.
light: Even diffuse material value. Scene carries light.
prompt: Image 1 is the material identity from the earlier Lampwater anchor and image 2 is a clean gouache paint crop from the Lampwater study. Ignore any reflection, border or interface detail from the references. Image 3 is the palette strip (Lampwater's dark, mid, light first; city swatches next). Match the style, proportions and finish of the attached anchors. Generate one opaque edge-to-edge square ground texture at the largest native square resolution, strict overhead orthographic. Material: blue-black canal water flowing towards the bottom of the image. A calmer stretch with spaced shorter oblique crests, staggered in two loose streams. Dark tapered longitudinal brush marks carry a sense of water moving down. No foam. Paint a legible gentle down-current gesture through low-contrast cool pigment and the shape of the ripples, with several distinct crests about 2–3 final pixels wide. A moderate current, no still pool, spiral, waves or shore. Dry-matte painted gouache quality despite the subject. Dominant #172C39 with subdued #456675 blue-teal ripples at mixed values around #193140. Use no amber #BC8A57 in the water; the lamp is a separate prop. Do not paint any vector flow arrow or other directional mark. Keep even low contrast in the large value masses everywhere. The scene supplies the upper-left key and warm lamps: give this tile even diffuse material value without any cast shadows, highlights, bright spots, light pools, reflections, shine, vignette, rim light, radial gradient, or centered motif. Broad matte 2D gouache paint with fine grain and sparse engraved material detail. Keep the texture recognizable at 51 px; equal value at edges and center, no border or perimeter seam. No text, letters, numbers, UI, frames, arrows, grid lines, reach dots, health bars, targeting rings, watermark, objects or figures.
